title: Persistent effects of early-life arsenic exposure in Caenorhabditis elegans
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00655D, Paper

Kathleen A. Hershberger, Shaza Gaballah, Britney Jiayu He, Luoyu Zhang, Emily Barefoot-Gautier, Caroline B. Reed, Nelson A. Rivera, Heileen Hsu-Kim, Joel N. Meyer
Worms exposed to sodium arsenite for 48 hours developed persistent changes in worm size and adiposity. Worms followed for three generations post-exposure were indistinguishable from progeny of non-exposed controls.
